findings: The signed raw-contact repair correctly reconstructs scalar×normal vectors, requires finite nonzero tab-mapped reactions, reconciles each complete fingertip–screen pair slice with the native filtered tensor, and bases opposition on mapped tab reactions.

The 3-second hold can still qualify below the required 30 mm lift: `hold_good` accepts `initial_z + 0.028`, while the separate 30 mm check uses the maximum height at any time. A transient 30 mm peak followed by a stationary 28 mm hold can therefore pass both checks. Require the hold samples themselves to remain at least 0.030 m above the initial height, or explicitly document and freeze a justified tolerance consistently in the qualification contract.
